There’s the proper place for you, out there. [ll marry you to the ocean.

@@U03663@@
Yield to the splendid desire! Begin your evolution at the beginning! Be ready for action, and never lose to doubt. Progress by eternal norms through many thousands of forms till finally you are man. But be prepared— that will take time.

@@U03664@@
(荷蒙库鲁斯 mounts the 普罗透斯-DOLPHIN.)

@@U03666@@
Come, bright spirit, let us plunge into the vast moisture of creation, where no dimension or direction will be denied you, and you will range at will! Take care, though, and don't strive for higher orders. Once you've attained the estate of man, you've reached the end, the rest is waste.

@@U03668@@
Well, that depends. It’s not all that bad being a worthy man in your own time.

@@U03670@@
(To 泰勒斯,)

@@U03671@@
Yes, well, if it’s one of your sort. They tend to last for awhile. You, for example,

@@U03661@@
那里有适合您的地方。 [将你嫁给大海。

@@U03663@@
屈服于美好的愿望！从头开始你的进化！做好行动的准备，永远不要输给怀疑。按照永恒的规范前进，经历成千上万的形式，直到最后你成为人。但要做好准备——这需要时间。

@@U03664@@
（荷蒙库鲁斯骑着普罗透斯-海豚。）

@@U03666@@
来吧，光明的灵魂，让我们投入造物的浩瀚湿润之中，在那里，没有任何维度或方向会拒绝你，你将随心所欲！不过要小心，不要争取更高的订单。一旦你达到了人类的境界，你就到达了终点，其余的都是浪费。

@@U03668@@
嗯，这要看情况。在你自己的时代做一个有价值的人并不是那么糟糕。

@@U03670@@
（致泰勒斯）

@@U03671@@
